description: This file implements various tensor pointwise operators for a fuzzing framework, including base classes and specific operators like add, multiply, subtract, divide, clamp, and cumsum.

classes.name: PointwiseOperator
classes.description: Base class for element-wise pointwise tensor operations, providing methods for input spec fuzzing and code generation.

classes.name: AddOperator
classes.description: Operator class for element-wise addition, inherits from PointwiseOperator.

classes.name: MulOperator
classes.description: Operator class for element-wise multiplication, inherits from PointwiseOperator.

classes.name: SubOperator
classes.description: Operator class for element-wise subtraction, inherits from PointwiseOperator.

classes.name: DivOperator
classes.description: Operator class for element-wise division, inherits from PointwiseOperator.

classes.name: ClampOperator
classes.description: Operator class for torch.clamp, with input spec generation and codegen for clamping tensors.

classes.name: CumsumOperator
classes.description: Operator class for torch.cumsum, generating input specs and code for cumulative sum along a tensor dimension.

methods.name: can_produce
methods.description: Determines if the operator can produce a tensor with the given output spec.

methods.name: fuzz_inputs_specs
methods.description: Generates input tensor specs for the operator based on the output spec.

methods.name: codegen
methods.description: Generates Python code for performing the tensor operation.
